knowledge:
- key_parameters: target=The genomic signal data to extract (can be a GRanges, RleList, or path to an indexed BAM/BigWig file) ;; windows=The genomic regions of interest (GRanges or GRangesList) over which enrichment is calculated ;; bin.num=The number of bins to split each window into (essential for unequal window widths in ScoreMatrixBin or ScoreMatrixList) ;; strand.aware=Logical indicating whether to reverse the orientation of matrix columns for windows on the negative strand ;; meta.col=A list specifying which columns of a tabular file to read as metadata in readGeneric (e.g., list(score=5)) ;; split.group=Logical indicating whether to split the last column of a GFF/GTF file into separate metadata columns in gffToGRanges ;; intersect.chr=Logical indicating whether to intersect chromosomes before annotation in annotateWithFeature or annotateWithGeneParts
- alternatives: AnnotationHub can be used to retrieve genomic annotations (like CpG islands or DNase peaks) directly from online repositories instead of reading local flat files.
- when_to_use: Use when you have genomic interval data (e.g., ChIP-seq peaks, BAM alignments, methylation scores) and want to visualize their distribution, average enrichment, or overlap with genomic annotations (e.g., promoters, TSS, exons, introns, CpG islands).
- pitfalls: Windows falling off the target: ScoreMatrix will warn if windows extend beyond chromosome boundaries or target limits ;; Unequal window widths: Using ScoreMatrix on windows of unequal width will fail or be inappropriate; ScoreMatrixBin must be used instead with a specified bin.num ;; Exons/windows shorter than bin.num: ScoreMatrixBin will filter out and remove windows that are shorter than the specified number of bins, which can lead to missing rows in the output matrix ;; BAM files must be indexed (have a corresponding .bai file) when used directly as targets.

workflows.name: genomic_signal_extraction_and_visualization
workflows.intent: Extract genomic signal (e.g., CAGE, ChIP-seq) over windows of interest (e.g., promoters, exons) and visualize via heatmaps or meta-plots.
workflows.stages: 1. Read genomic annotations using gffToGRanges ;; 2. Build score matrices over windows using ScoreMatrix (equal width) or ScoreMatrixBin (unequal width) ;; 3. Combine multiple targets into a ScoreMatrixList ;; 4. Scale matrices using scaleScoreMatrix or scaleScoreMatrixList ;; 5. Visualize using heatMatrix, plotMeta, or multiHeatMatrix.
workflows.code:
data(cage)
data(promoters)
sm = ScoreMatrix(target=cage, windows=promoters)
sm

gff.file = system.file('extdata/chr21.refseq.hg19.gtf', package="genomation")
exons = gffToGRanges(gff.file, filter='exon')
sm = ScoreMatrixBin(target=cage, windows=exons, bin.num=50)
sm

transcripts = split(exons, exons$transcript_id)
sm = ScoreMatrixBin(target=cage, windows=transcripts, bin.num=10)
sm

cage$tpm = NULL
targets = list(cage=cage, cpgi=cpgi)
sm = ScoreMatrixList(targets=targets, windows=promoters, bin.num=50)
sm

heatMatrix(sm, xcoords=c(-1000, 1000))
plotMeta(sm, xcoords=c(-1000, 1000))

sm = ScoreMatrix(target=cage, windows=promoters, strand.aware=TRUE)
cpg.ind = which(countOverlaps(promoters, cpgi)>0)
nocpg.ind = which(countOverlaps(promoters, cpgi)==0)
heatMatrix(sm, xcoords=c(-1000, 1000), group=list(CpGi=cpg.ind, noCpGi=nocpg.ind))

sm.scaled = scaleScoreMatrix(sm)
heatMatrix(sm.scaled, xcoords=c(-1000, 1000), group=list(CpGi=cpg.ind, noCpGi=nocpg.ind))

sml = ScoreMatrixList(targets=targets, windows=promoters, bin.num=50, strand.aware=TRUE)
multiHeatMatrix(sml, xcoords=c(-1000, 1000))
multiHeatMatrix(sml, xcoords=c(-1000, 1000), clustfun=function(x) kmeans(x, centers=2)$cluster)

workflows.name: genomic_interval_annotation
workflows.intent: Annotate genomic intervals (e.g., ChIP-seq peaks) with genomic features (e.g., CpG islands) or gene parts (promoters, exons, introns, TSS).
workflows.stages: 1. Read peaks using readBroadPeak, readNarrowPeak, or readGeneric ;; 2. Read transcript features using readTranscriptFeatures ;; 3. Annotate intervals using annotateWithFeature or annotateWithGeneParts ;; 4. Plot annotation statistics using plotGeneAnnotation or plotTargetAnnotation.
workflows.code:
genomationDataPath = system.file('extdata',package='genomationData')
sampleInfo = read.table(file.path(genomationDataPath, 'SamplesInfo.txt'), 
                        header=TRUE, sep='\t', stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

peak.files=list.files(genomationDataPath, full.names=TRUE, pattern='broadPeak')
names(peak.files) = sampleInfo$sampleName[match(basename(peak.files),sampleInfo$fileName)]

ctcf.peaks = readBroadPeak(peak.files['Ctcf'])

data(cpgi)
peak.annot = annotateWithFeature(ctcf.peaks, cpgi, intersect.chr=TRUE)
peak.annot

bed.file=system.file("extdata/chr21.refseq.hg19.bed", package = "genomation")
gene.parts = readTranscriptFeatures(bed.file)

ctcf.annot=annotateWithGeneParts(ctcf.peaks, gene.parts, intersect.chr=TRUE)
ctcf.annot

peaks = GRangesList(lapply(peak.files, readGeneric))
names(peaks) = names(peak.files)
annot.list = annotateWithGeneParts(peaks, gene.parts, intersect.chr=TRUE)

plotGeneAnnotation(annot.list)
plotGeneAnnotation(annot.list, cluster=TRUE)

workflows.name: feature_combination_analysis
workflows.intent: Find combinations of overlapping genomic features (e.g., multiple transcription factor peaks) and visualize their signal.
workflows.stages: 1. Read multiple peak files into a GRangesList ;; 2. Find combinations of features using findFeatureComb ;; 3. Extract signal over these combinations using ScoreMatrixList ;; 4. Scale and plot using multiHeatMatrix.
workflows.code:
genomationDataPath = system.file('extdata',package='genomationData')
sampleInfo = read.table(file.path(genomationDataPath, 'SamplesInfo.txt'), 
                        header=TRUE, sep='\t', stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

peak.files = list.files(genomationDataPath, full.names=TRUE, pattern='Peak.gz$')
peaks = list()
for(i in 1:length(peak.files)){
  file = peak.files[i]
  name=sampleInfo$sampleName[match(basename(file),sampleInfo$fileName)]
  message(name)
  peaks[[name]] = readGeneric(file, meta.col=list(score=5))
}
peaks = GRangesList(peaks)
peaks = peaks[seqnames(peaks) == 'chr21' & width(peaks) < 1000  & width(peaks) > 100]

tf.comb = findFeatureComb(peaks, width=1000)

tf.comb = tf.comb[order(tf.comb$class)]
bam.files = list.files(genomationDataPath, full.names=TRUE, pattern='bam$')
bam.files = bam.files[!grepl('Cage', bam.files)]
sml = ScoreMatrixList(bam.files, tf.comb, bin.num=20, type='bam')
names(sml) = sampleInfo$sampleName[match(names(sml),sampleInfo$fileName)]
sml.scaled = scaleScoreMatrixList(sml)
multiHeatMatrix(sml.scaled, xcoords=c(-500, 500), col=c('lightgray', 'blue'))
